reason: Loom is primarily an orchestration control plane for planning, verifying, activating, and recovering coordinated DeepSeek Harness plugin and configuration changes through isolated implementation and gated execution.

summaries.zh: Loom 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的编排控制面，用于规划、验证、原子激活和恢复插件及配置的协同演进。
summaries.en: Loom is an orchestration control plane for planning, verifying, atomically activating, and recovering coordinated plugin and configuration changes in DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Plans and executes controlled evolution of DeepSeek Harness plugins, Config, and Skills
Installs, updates, removes, and restores plugin packages
Coordinates isolated Builder implementation with Verifier and Gate approval
Runs builds, tests, contract checks, and cold-profile verification
Performs atomic activation and rollback of supported plugin combinations
Maintains persistent task plans, snapshots, reports, and recovery receipts
